# Methods {#sec-methods}

```{r}
#| include: false
source("../_setup.R")
pkgs <- c("ggplot2", "knitr", "yaml")
ver <- function(p) as.character(packageVersion(p))
r_version <- paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = ".")
sc <- synth_counts(n_per_group = 4)
```

Methods prose is generated from the run's parameters and from the package versions that loaded at render time. It is never typed. Copy it into a paper as it stands.

## Analysis {#sec-methods-analysis}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
cat(paste0(
  "Counts were simulated for ", fmt(nrow(sc$counts)), " features in two groups of ",
  sum(sc$samples$group == "treated"), " samples ",
  "(synthetic example data). Features with a mean count below ", report_param("min_count"),
  " were removed. Counts were converted to log2 counts per million with a prior count of 1. ",
  "Each feature was compared between groups with a Welch two-sample t-test, and p-values ",
  "were adjusted with the Benjamini-Hochberg method. A feature passed when its adjusted ",
  "p-value was below ", report_param("fdr"), " and its absolute log2 fold change was at least ",
  report_param("lfc_threshold"), ". The minimum detectable effect used a normal approximation ",
  "at power ", report_param("power"), ". Analyses used R ", r_version, " [@r], ggplot2 ",
  ver("ggplot2"), " [@ggplot2], and knitr ", ver("knitr"), " [@knitr]. The report was ",
  "rendered with Quarto [@quarto].\n"
))
```
